text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden. I have 6 years of experience in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, and I’m interested in helping with your YouTube and social media video editing work.

While my core background is in machine learning rather than traditional video editing, I do have experience building AI-driven systems and working with tools that support content automation and generation. I understand the importance of storytelling, consistency, and audience engagement across YouTube and social platforms, and I’m comfortable working in environments where quality, speed, and clear collaboration matter.

One relevant project I’d like to share is Telecom churn prediction. I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read. The model achieved an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter and delivered a top-decile lift of 3.1x. That project required careful iteration, attention to detail, and translating complex outputs into something practical for a team to use—skills that carry over well when shaping polished, audience-ready content and aligning work to a defined style or brand tone.

I also work comfortably with AI-related tools and workflows, so if you’re looking for support with AI-powered video concepts or automation around content production, I can contribute there as well. I’m used to collaborating with teams, following structured requirements, and delivering work that stays consistent with the goals of the project.

If shortlisted, I’d be glad to share more about my background and discuss how I can support your editing workflow and content needs. Do you already have a preferred editing workflow or style guide for the YouTube and social media videos?
